mechanism_families.verdict: NOT APPLICABLE at the deployed size, and now on a MEASUREMENT
mechanism_families.why: the deployed book turns ~$651 of notional per day (positions median $733, p95 $1,834, median hold 168 h, from its 1,111 real trades). Of the 12.0 bps calm round trip, 10.0 bps is the size-independent taker fee and the measured spread+roll at aggregate market volume is 1.02 bps calm / 12.47 bps COVID, against a measured gross edge of 182 bps of notional per trade - so impact would have to reach ~168x the market's own aggregate flow before the edge is consumed. The earlier '$0.8M-3.9M/day impact budget' was REMOVED as unsupported: shark_data/costs/depth_cache has only ten bands at +/-1% to +/-5% from the mid, so its finest observation is 48.8-156.6 bps and it cannot produce a capacity figure at all; impact_by_size.csv's 261 rows of exactly 100.0 bps ARE that +/-1% floor. Also the freqtrade backtester has no slippage or impact model, so this could not have been settled by backtesting

how_to_use_this_file: Before scouting or screening: read mechanism_families and do not return any of them.
Before opening a new line on the delivered book: read optimisation_axes_on_the_delivered_4h_book and confirm the new line is not one of them re-parameterised.
A closed line reopens only with NEW INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE - a new paper, new data, a structural change - not with a better-looking backtest.
